SRP (Philippine / typical market base price – brand new in 2012): Approx. ₱610,000 – ₱740,000 (Varied by trim and transmission at time of release)
SPECS:
Overall Dimensions (mm): 4,370 × 1,700 × 1,460 Wheelbase (mm): 2,570 Seating Capacity: 5
ENGINE / PERFORMANCE
Engine Options:
1.4 L 4-Cylinder Gasoline (DOHC, MPI)
Maximum Output: ~107 hp Maximum Torque: ~135 Nm
1.6 L 4-Cylinder Gasoline (DOHC, MPI)
Maximum Output: ~121 hp Maximum Torque: ~155 Nm
Transmission: 5-speed Manual or 4-speed Automatic Drivetrain: Front-Wheel Drive (FWD)
CAPACITY & CAPABILITIES
Towing Capacity: Not officially rated; not recommended for towing
Payload Capacity: Approx. 400–450 kg
Fuel Tank Capacity: 43 L
INTERIOR / CABIN / SPACE
Seating: 5
Infotainment: Basic audio system (radio / CD / USB depending on variant)
Speakers: 4
CHASSIS / BRAKES / WHEELS / SUSPENSION
Front Brake / Rear Brake: Ventilated Disc / Drum
Suspension: MacPherson Strut front, Torsion Beam rear
Tires / Wheels: 175/70 R14 Steel Wheels (standard), 16” Alloy on higher trims
